Nov 2019
Location: Near Phu Dong roundabout, opposite New World 5-star Hotel. The restaurant has nothing outstanding, I went by several times without noticing (because the restaurant is small). Incidentally the other day it rained so I stop at here and I can notice this place.
✅ Have motorbike parking, keep FREE.
---------------------
Space: Also clean, cool. 1 ground & 1 floor. The ground floor is quite modest, just about 5 or 6 tables for guests. Because at here, they just almost focus for sale to the shipper of App Food Delivery (GoViet, Grab, Now, etc )
---------------------
Staff: Normal.
--------------------
Price: I ate "Combo burger fish" : 39.000 dong, just discount on Monday (original price 50000). Monday - Friday have special offers. Especially, thursday & friday, they have Buy1 Get1 (Get another 1, with price lower than the one you choose before 😑).
--------------------
Quality: The burger is delicious, but it very different than in a picture😧. It looks ugly & very small👎. 
✅ French fries are perfect, so good💚. Drink can refill unlimit 😍.

They even all swear and talk to each other, make me can't swallow.

👉 Advise B.K to hang the sign outside: "Prohibit shipper be allow sitting in restaurant". The f**king shipper can sit when they buy, otherwise must stand. Because of that, so now, shipper come in come out, sitting around, even sitting with the guests as if this table is theirs 💢😡🖕

Better than mac donalds, better than KFC
Jul 2016 • Couples
After eating at mac donalds,
And after 4-5 times of Kfc saigon,
Nothing can beat burger king. 

All of their burgers are superior in both taste and quality. 
The big crispy well fried fries are one of my favorites. 
I was surprised by how good their chicken wings combo menu was. 
6 large pieces + 2 sodas for 200,000 VND
But far better chicken than Kfc. 
Not greasy at all, and grilled instead of deep fried. Excellent choice of marinade. 
Expensive for vietnam but totally worth it. 

Good service. Staff knows how to converse in english. Almost feels like at home. 
Good place to cure a hangover or when you are tired of pho noodles.

Will definitely be back!
